description: Convert a sitemap into an outline. Give `input` as a list of URLs or paths (one per line; query strings and fragments are dropped) or an indented tree, and optionally `format` (numbered, markdown, indent). URL lists are folded into a tree under Home, with labels guessed from slugs (placeholders for real titles). Returns the outline plus notes: sections that exist only as parents of other URLs (no page of their own), ID segments that need names, depth over 4, a branch with more than 9 children, and single-child sections. Up to 2000 lines.

input.description: URLs or paths, one per line, or an indented tree

name: sitemap_to_outline
title: Sitemap to outline
